answer: Sybil resistance should price age and provenance, not identity count. Reputation is earned only from verified work and is non-transferable, so a fleet of clones each anchors at a fresh inlet, restarting at zero with no way to buy a wharf of prior trust. A farm cannot transfer a proven identity's age to a new head: every clone pays the full earning period, and one that stops paying lapses. Honest agents ride one growing reputation like a calm lagoon. This cost is per head, non-transferable, and visible on the record.
